scope: Read-only validation of the existing Hanyang student's normal viewer authorization and a separate collector process. No production code/configuration changes, LMS writes, audio, recording controls, translation-generation commands, or transcript imports.

runtime.credentialIssuer: Existing Core Node container; production SQLite opened readonly; no AuthService initialization
runtime.collector: Separate Node process in /tmp; explicitly supplied environment contains PATH only

upstreamSource.studentUiBehavior: Live-view button disabled after session ends; replay button shown only when viewer_public is true; caption-download UI shown only when enable_caption_download is true.
upstreamSource.socketDenialUi: Viewer access denied. is routed to the school's viewer_denied page.
upstreamSource.viewerPageGuard: The viewer page locally rejects an ended, non-public session only when vtoken is absent. A supplied vtoken allows the socket handshake to proceed; server authorization can still reject it.

successfulHistory.interpretation: The correct viewer credential is recognized as an identified viewer. Anonymous and mismatched-credential access to this public session returns the same public history via a guest connection. This does not establish access to restricted history or quantify live latency.

restrictedHistory.interpretation: Six isolated connections were rejected even with freshly issued viewer credentials. These sessions also had post-class replay disabled, but this correlation does not establish the reason for server rejection. The official viewer page exempts vtoken-bearing requests from its local ended/non-public guard. A same-session comparison with the user's normal signed-in browser is still required.

sourceFinding.currentBehavior: Rejects viewer_public=false regardless of recording state and always supplies a null vtoken.
sourceFinding.implication: This conflates post-class replay settings with current live-view eligibility. The official student UI treats these separately. A live-class test is required before implementing a corrected permission-aware adapter.

notYetVerified: Same-session comparison between a normal signed-in school browser and the isolated collector, including the user's reported successful post-class access
Identified access to an in-progress class with post-class replay disabled
Full-class connection stability, token expiry and unattended renewal over 24 hours
Korean partial/final/correction event granularity and Chinese realtime timing
Mid-class history-to-live merging and measured browser display latency
Credential issuance and school calls running in the actual Sites runtime
architectureConclusion: Separating the long-lived PAT from the collector is supported by the observed per-session viewer credential and isolated public-history read. Full acceptance remains pending matched browser/collector, live-class and Sites-runtime tests. Post-class access is demonstrably possible for the public control; the six rejected collector connections do not establish a blanket post-class prohibition or exclude a missing requirement in the collector's authorization flow.

followUpCorrection.userObservation: The user reports previously reopening or viewing captions after class; exact session and whether the page was newly opened remain unspecified.
followUpCorrection.correctedClaim: Do not attribute Viewer access denied solely to disabled replay, or equate viewer_public=false with authenticated student denial.
followUpCorrection.browserComparison: No Hanyang tab was found in the selected in-app browser; no matching signed-in browser comparison has been completed.
